parameters.name: BandwidthPackageId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT service plan.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~36569~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the NAT gateway is deployed. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
